## A record of learning in space

This site is designed as a working atlas rather than a finished portfolio. Each future entry will begin with a spatial question, make the analytical choices traceable, and end with an interpretation that matters beyond the map.
:::
:::

::: {.atlas-principles}
::: {.atlas-principle}
<span>01</span>
### Observe

Look for distributions, relationships, scale, and the context a dataset leaves out.
:::

::: {.atlas-principle}
<span>02</span>
### Model

Build reproducible spatial workflows where assumptions and limitations remain visible.
:::

::: {.atlas-principle}
<span>03</span>
### Communicate

Use maps and prose together so that evidence becomes clear without becoming simplistic.
:::
:::
